out: state fold as one callable (state_fold.py) - waterline, verbatim window, append-only archive

R2245: the state.json log fold was a hand-run surgical habit - the window was picked by counting lines, the waterline was eyeballed, and the archive append was a bespoke script each time, so every fold was another chance to cut a round line in half or to rewrite the archive instead of appending to it. src/os/state_fold.py owns the three decisions once. measure(disk_bytes) returns the waterline verdict from the real disk size (bytes, gate, margin, fold_needed, verdict in the closed set FOLD-CLEAR/FOLD-DUE, with 78500 exactly at the gate reading clear). plan_fold(raw, state, w1, w2, summary) is the fold predicate and writes nothing: it reports the window line count and content bytes, proves every PAT token in the window appears in the summary, predicts the post-fold disk size, and builds the exact prefix+[summary]+suffix splice on the canonical 16-space CRLF layout, refusing a file whose item lines do not match its parsed log length (E_SF_BAD_LAYOUT), an out-of-bounds window (E_SF_WINDOW) and a multi-line summary instead of guessing. append_archive(path, header, lines) appends the header plus the window lines verbatim, proves the old bytes are a strict prefix of the new bytes, repairs a missing trailing newline, creates the archive only under allow_create with a preamble, and verifies the read-back. fold(root, ...) is the single callable that plans, writes a byte-identical backup (read back), appends the archive, atomically replaces state.json, and then proves post bytes == predicted bytes and the new log == prefix+[summary]+suffix. check(root) is the read-only --check report (exit 0 clear / 2 due or bad flags / 3 unreadable) and writes nothing at all. Evidence: SUITE PASS 6/6 double-run byte-identical criterion sha16 921DC309BDA01051 (qa/state-fold-R2245-a.log and -b.log, 728B per leg, single writer utf-8 LF by src/os/evidence_R2245.py, never a shell redirection), wired os-state-fold(6) in src/sandbox/reconcile_all.py, six adjacent os suites green plus the live --check rc=0 (qa/regression-R2245.log, fails=0).
